description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations -  Industrial Disputes between  G. W. Nandasiri and Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific dispute. It references a specific law (Chapter 131), includes an order made under its provisions (Section 4(1)), and outlines a legal/regulatory procedure for dispute resolution. While a Minister is named, the core content is a legal/regulatory action (appointing an arbitrator under statutory authority) rather than a government personnel appointment or a description of ministerial portfolios. Therefore, it fits best under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes.
